name: Genetic Engineering
overview: Scripture reveals that God created living things to reproduce according to their own kinds, establishing clear boundaries in nature as seen in Genesis 1:11 and Leviticus 19:19. Humanity, made in God's image (Genesis 1:26), holds a unique role and responsibility over creation, yet the sanctity of God's design is emphasized by prohibitions against mixing seeds or animals of different kinds (Deuteronomy 22:9). Moreover, the intimate care of God in forming each person within the womb (Psalms 139:13-14) underscores the divine craftsmanship that genetic engineering must respectfully acknowledge.
